description: Stateless in-memory transformation and PDF synthesis converting an Estimate/Quote JSON into an Invoice, Receipt, or Credit Note without mutating server records. Example: convert_document({"document":{},"target_type":"invoice"})

credit_reason.description: Reason for issuing credit note or refund (e.g. Overbilling, Cancellation).

document.description: Stateless input document JSON payload to transform (returns a new synthesized document without mutating server records).

due_days.description: Number of days until payment is due (for invoice conversion).

payment_link.description: Optional checkout URL to embed as a vector QR code and clickable link.

payment_qr_code.description: Whether to render an SVG vector QR code for 1-scan mobile payment.

target_type.description: Target lifecycle document type (invoice, receipt, estimate, credit_note, refund).

name: convert_document

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded vector PDF of the converted document.

title: Stateless Document Lifecycle Conversion
